name: Reflect
tagline: AI-powered note-taking with networked thinking and backlinks
painPoints: Limited to note-taking; no task, email, or calendar management
AI features are focused on writing assistance, not proactive intelligence
Expensive at $10/month for what remains a note editor
No mobile offline support in early versions
Smaller ecosystem and fewer integrations than Obsidian or Notion
metaDescription: Looking for a Reflect alternative? GAIA is open-source AI that triages email, manages tasks, and runs workflows across 50+ tools. Free tier included.
whyPeopleLook: Reflect is a beautifully designed note-taking app with good AI writing assistance and networked linking. But like all note apps, it requires you to actively write in it. There is no connection to your email, no calendar awareness, and no proactive intelligence beyond writing suggestions. Users who want their knowledge tool to do more — to learn from their digital activity and surface information proactively — find Reflect too passive.
gaiaReplaces: Automatic knowledge capture from email and calendar activity
Proactive information surfacing based on current work context
Meeting and correspondence memory without active note-taking
Semantic knowledge retrieval across all your connected tools
gaiaAdvantages: Knowledge is captured passively: no need to actively write notes
Email and calendar integrate to build context automatically
Proactive: surfaces relevant past knowledge based on what you're doing now
Open-source and self-hostable; Reflect is closed-source SaaS
Full productivity assistant beyond a note-taking app
migrationSteps: Export notes from Reflect as Markdown
Import into GAIA's memory system for semantic retrieval
Connect Gmail and Google Calendar for automatic knowledge building
Use GAIA's conversational queries to access your knowledge without searching

faqs.question: Does GAIA have a note editor like Reflect?
faqs.answer: GAIA does not have a dedicated Markdown note editor. It builds and retrieves knowledge through conversation and automatic data capture from connected tools. For active writing, Reflect or Obsidian are still better choices.

faqs.question: Is GAIA cheaper than Reflect?
faqs.answer: Reflect costs $10/month. GAIA Pro is ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month but includes email, calendar, tasks, memory, and 50+ integrations. Self-hosted GAIA is free.

faqs.question: Can GAIA replace Reflect for networked note-taking?
faqs.answer: GAIA's graph-based memory creates networks between people, projects, and events automatically from your digital activity. This is a different approach to networked thinking — emergent rather than manually constructed.

faqs.question: Is GAIA open-source while Reflect is not?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA is fully open-source on GitHub. Reflect is a closed-source SaaS product. With GAIA you can self-host and audit the code.

comparisonRows.gaia: Knowledge graph that captures itself from email and calendar, with a full assistant attached
comparisonRows.competitor: AI-powered networked note-taking app that mirrors how your brain works through backlinks, daily notes, and conversational AI over your personal knowledge graph

comparisonRows.gaia: Daily understanding assembled from real activity plus transcription and imports, with no active writing required
comparisonRows.competitor: Core strength: daily notes, rich backlink system, voice transcription with Whisper, Kindle highlight import, web clipping, and AI-assisted writing with GPT-4o or Claude

comparisonRows.gaia: Inbox triaged with replies drafted and acted on, not appended to daily notes through workarounds
comparisonRows.competitor: No native email management; supports basic Zapier automations to append starred emails to daily notes as a workaround; cannot triage, draft replies, or act on your inbox

comparisonRows.gaia: Full task management fed by email and calendar, beyond checklists that defer to another app
comparisonRows.competitor: Basic checklist and task items within notes; Reflect's stated goal is not to be a full task manager and recommends pairing with dedicated apps like Things for project tracking

comparisonRows.gaia: AI that executes across tools from knowledge, beyond writing assistance over the note graph
comparisonRows.competitor: AI writing assistance, grammar checks, custom prompts, voice-to-text transcription, and conversational chat over your note graph using GPT-4o or Claude 3.5 Sonnet

comparisonRows.gaia: Events created, modified, and briefed, not imported read-only into notes
comparisonRows.competitor: Google Calendar and Outlook sync imports events into daily notes with attendees and agenda; one-click meeting notes creation; read-only: cannot create or modify calendar events

comparisonRows.gaia: Cross-tool multi-step actions from conversation, with no Zapier piping in between
comparisonRows.competitor: No native workflow automation engine; limited indirect automations available via Zapier for piping external content into notes; no cross-tool multi-step action support

comparisonRows.gaia: Open source and self-hostable, where Reflect is closed-source SaaS
comparisonRows.competitor: Closed-source proprietary SaaS; data is end-to-end encrypted on Reflect's servers; no self-hosting option available

comparisonRows.gaia: Free tier available instead of a single paid plan with only a trial; Pro from ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month; self-hosting free
comparisonRows.competitor: Single paid plan at $10,$15/month (billed annually) with a two-week free trial; no permanent free tier; all features included in the single plan
